ns2:course.label: Macrofinance
ns2:course.description: Overview of the workings of the financial sector of the macro economy; includes the roles of financial institutions, financial markets, macroeconomic policies, interest rates, and the flows of funds. Prerequisite: FIN 520; or MBA 505 - Section G (Finance II); or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: FIN 520; or MBA 505 - Section G (Finance II); or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to MS: Finance Cost Rec - UIUC or MBA:Bus Administration -UIUC.
